seed_rule: For i=0..15 hash the exact UTF-8 bytes of 'NSD-NB1-v0.2-B01|replicate|i' with SHA-256; read digest bytes 0..7 as unsigned big-endian 64-bit integer; reduce modulo (2^63-1).
collision_rule: If a generated seed is zero or duplicates any earlier replicate seed, append '|retry|j' with j=1,2,... to the original input and repeat until nonzero and unique. No retry is required by the v0.2 candidate list.
serialization: Seeds are decimal strings to prevent binary64/JSON rounding.
correction_reason: v0.1 decimal seeds were serialized through binary64 and do not exactly equal the declared SHA-256 rule. No outcome was opened; identities are corrected prospectively before freeze.
